STORYTIME I was in school for teaching for 3 1/2 years. 3 days into student teaching, my cooperating teacher didn't want to deal with me anymore. Instead of using the tools in place to deal situations just like this, they kicked me out of the program 1/?

When I was invited to the conversation, I was asked my thoughts only as a formality. I has a LOT financially and emotionally riding on coming out of college that semester as a teacher. I told her I saw my future burning in front of me. 4/?

And that's the story of how I was betrayed by the teaching community, how I graduated (Cum Laude, I might add) with an English degree I didn't really earn, and how I was diagnosed with depression at the end of college :D <3. Thanks for listening to my rant <3. 6/6
